status.part.rate_limit: Fragment appended to a fan status. The leading space is deliberate: keep it. {pending} is on/off. The clock {t} is already formatted.
status.part.blind_stops: Fragment appended to a fan status; keep the leading space.
status.part.blind_stop_pending: Fragment appended to a fan status; keep the leading space.
status.part.blind_no_stop: Fragment appended to a fan status; keep the leading space.
status.part.ends: Fragment appended to a status line; keep the leading space.
status.part.fan_hold: Fragment appended to a status line after a dash; keep the leading space and the dash.
status.part.fan_run: Fragment appended to a status line after a dash; keep the leading space and the dash.
status.part.cause: Fragment appended to a status line after a dash; {cause} is a short noun phrase (see status.grace_cause.*). Keep the leading space and the dash.
status.part.remaining: Fragment appended to a grace-period status line. {dur} is a duration such as '30 min' or '1.5h', {t} a clock time. Keep the leading space and the dash.
status.part.grace_detail: Only joins its parts (cause, fan request, remaining time). Do not add words.
status.part.fan_requests: Only joins its parts. Do not add words.
status.fan_status.compound: Only joins a fan status and its notes. Do not add words.
status.fan_status.disabled: A state value of the fan card (lower case, short). The English text is a fixed token that automations may compare; translate it as a label.
status.auto.grace_note: Fragment appended to a 'paused' status line; keep the leading ' · '. {source} is 'automation' or 'manual'.
status.auto.grace_period: Status line while a grace period (a pause in automatic control after the occupant changed something) runs. {source} is 'automation' or 'manual'; {detail} is a ready-made tail such as ' — WHF turned off — 30 min (ends 3:00 PM)' and may be empty.
status.auto.with_fan_requests: Only joins the status line and its fan-request note. Do not add words.
status.auto.paused_away: {grace} is a ready-made tail and may be empty.
status.auto.paused_vacation: {grace} is a ready-made tail and may be empty.
status.auto.paused_door_window: {grace} is a ready-made tail and may be empty.
status.hold.range: A temperature range such as 60–80°F. {lo} is a bare number, {hi} carries the unit symbol.
status.hold.sentence: Starts a sentence. 'Pre-cooling'/'Pre-heating' means the house is deliberately cooled/heated early before an expensive electricity period.
status.hold.sentence_lc: The same sentence for use after a colon or inside another sentence: start with a lower-case letter where the language has case.
status.next_action.opening_would_help: Advice to the occupant; 'a window period' means a time the automation planned for opening windows.
status.next_action.open_windows_cooler_f: {fan} is 'yes' when a fan is configured; then the sentence also offers turning on the fan.
status.promise.settling_flip: Debug-tab label of an internal self-check; {n} is the check's number. Keep the number first.
status.indoor_source.reason_inconsistent: The temperature unit is always degrees Fahrenheit here; keep ' °F'.
status.comfort_hold.holding: Debug text. {where} is a clause (see status.comfort_hold.where_*); 'ran N min ago' refers to the opposite mode (heating/cooling).
status.remote_offset.main: {label} is 'Bedroom' or 'Remote sensor'; {amount} and {note} are short phrases in parentheses.
status.remote_offset.gap_whole: A temperature gap with a degree sign and no unit letter (4°).
status.remote_offset.gap_frac: A temperature gap with a degree sign and no unit letter (2.5°).
status.thermostat_notice.text: {use} is a clause that ends the first sentence; keep the semicolon structure or use the language's equivalent.
status.next_action_away_1: Light-hearted line shown when the occupant is away. Keep the tone; no need to translate literally.
status.next_action_vacation_1: Light-hearted line shown when the occupant is on vacation. Keep the tone; no need to translate literally.
status.pa_reason.bias_over: Why a prediction-accuracy row did not pass (hover text). |bias| is the absolute value of the average prediction error in degrees F; keep the vertical bars and the > sign. {bias} is already a two-decimal number.
status.pa_reason.coverage_low: Why a prediction-accuracy row did not pass (hover text). Coverage is the share (0 to 1) of points the v4 model answered; keep the < sign. v3 / v4 are engine names: do not translate.
status.pa_reason.not_enough_data: Why a prediction-accuracy row did not pass (hover text). n is the number of points so far, need the number required; keep the n= form.
